Authentication happens at your proxy

This deployment uses forward-auth — the reverse proxy should authenticate you and inject identity headers before a request reaches the app. Seeing this page means it didn't: check the proxy configuration (authentik/Authelia/oauth2-proxy) and the FORWARD_AUTH_TRUSTED_PROXIES allowlist.
